Changing or Cancelling an Order - Cancelling an order
You can cancel an order within 45 minutes of placing it, from the Orders page of your account. After 45 minutes the order is sent to the warehouse and can no longer be cancelled; you can return it once it arrives.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/refunds.md">
Returns and Refunds - Return shipping
A prepaid return label costs $6.95, and the amount is deducted from your refund. If the item arrived defective or damaged, the return label is free.
</document>

<document source="data/kb/order-changes.md">
Changing or Cancelling an Order - Changing items
Items cannot be added to or swapped in an existing order. Cancel the order and place a new one instead. A cancelled order is refunded within 2 business days.
</document>
